body:
﻿### Problem

DynamicVideoBackend / opencv_dynamic can receive invalid timing metadata from OpenCV-backed video loading, such as a non-positive frame count, duration, source FPS, or target FPS.

When that metadata is not validated before dynamic sampling, the loader can produce invalid frame selections that flow toward frame decoding. For metadata-poor videos, this can turn the root cause into a less clear downstream frame-index/decode failure.

### Expected behavior

The dynamic video sampler should reject invalid timing metadata early with a clear error, before frame reads/decoding are attempted.

Valid ultra-short videos with positive metadata should still be accepted by sampling at least one frame.

### Related PR

This is addressed by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/48331.
